instruction:
You route a user's request to a voice assistant to exactly one category.
Categories, each with examples of request types it already handles (it also handles other, similar request types that are not listed):
- alarm: e.g. alarm remove
- audio: e.g. audio volume down, audio volume other
- calendar: e.g. calendar set
- cooking: e.g. cooking query, cooking recipe
- datetime: e.g. datetime convert, datetime query
- email: e.g. email addcontact, email sendemail
- general: e.g. general joke
- iot: e.g. iot cleaning, iot coffee, iot hue lightchange, iot hue lighton, iot wemo off
- lists: e.g. lists remove
- music: e.g. music likeness, music settings
- news: e.g. news query
- play: e.g. play audiobook, play music, play podcasts
- qa: e.g. qa definition, qa maths, qa stock
- recommendation: e.g. recommendation locations
- social: e.g. social post, social query
- takeaway: e.g. takeaway order, takeaway query
- transport: e.g. transport ticket, transport traffic
- weather: e.g. weather query
- none_of_these: the request does not belong to any category above.
Examples:
"remove my earliest alarm for tomorrow" -> alarm
"lower speaker volume" -> audio
"change the volume of the speakers" -> audio
"can you enter an event to my calendar" -> calendar
"olly can i use brown sugar instead of white in peanut butter cookies" -> cooking
"olly how do i cook a pasta" -> cooking
"what time will it be locally at nine am bangalore india time" -> datetime
"what's the time" -> datetime
"store my contacts" -> email
"drop a message to jan write i will be late" -> email
"tell me a good doctor joke" -> general
"vacuum the house olly" -> iot
"make coffee" -> iot
"turn the lights blue" -> iot
"turn on the lights" -> iot
"please turn off my smart plug socket" -> iot
"please remove tricep pull down from my workout list" -> lists
"remember this music" -> music
"please turn on repeat all" -> music
"is narendra modi the indian prime minister visiting any country now" -> news
"alexa resume joes book from where i left off last time" -> play
"after this one play song" -> play
"can you play the podcast from tomatojuicecom" -> play
"define philosophy" -> qa
"if i have fifty dollars and spend twenty four how many dollars will i have left" -> qa
"amazon stock price" -> qa
"where is the nearest olive garden" -> recommendation
"send a message to national grid that the power is out again" -> social
"give me some funny facebook posts" -> social
"i want to order a takeaway from papa john's" -> takeaway
"does this place do takeaway" -> takeaway
"olly i need to get to bristol friday night can you book me a ticket please" -> transport
"how bad is the traffic near the airport" -> transport
"is the sun gonna shine in devon this weekend" -> weather
Reply with only the category name, nothing else.
